original_query: What are two approaches for Association mapping?

confirmed.answer_text: LD-based Association mapping is one of the two main approaches for gene mapping.; Family-based Linkage mapping is the other main approach, but it is not an Association mapping method.
confirmed.summary: The page explains the purpose of gene mapping, which is to find molecular markers linked to target genes for use in marker-assisted selection (MAS), and presents two main approaches: Family-based Linkage mapping and LD-based Association mapping.
key_facts: LD-based Association mapping is one of the two main approaches for gene mapping.
Family-based Linkage mapping is the other main approach, but it is not an Association mapping method.
